lesson-grammar-and-structure-tenses-and-.quote: Ang **pandiwa** (verb) ay nagsasaad ng kilos, pangyayari, o kalagayan.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-tenses-and-.note: The advanced English morphology sentence is replaced by a short Filipino definition.

lesson-grammar-and-structure-tenses-and-.quote: Ipinapakita ng **aspekto** (aspect) kung tapos na, nagpapatuloy, gagawin pa, o katatapos lamang ang kilos.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-tenses-and-.note: The first teaching definition supplies the English gloss and the four meanings; no preceding body heading introduces an unglossed term.

language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.quote: Ang *nag-* sa pangkat na *maglinis* ay nagpapakita ng natapos na kilos.
language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.note: Completed aspect now has a form-selection method and a reasoned application in Example 1.

language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.quote: Nagsimula na ang pagsusulat ngunit hindi pa tapos.
language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.note: Ongoing aspect is explained by unfinished action; Examples 2, 7, and 8 also distinguish ongoing past and habitual uses.

language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.quote: Sa *kumain*, alisin ang *-um-* at ulitin ang *ka*: *kakain*.
language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.note: Contemplated action is tied to not-yet-started meaning, and Example 5 applies the formation method.

language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.note: Recently completed action is distinguished from ordinary completion and justified in Example 4.

language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.quote: Huwag ilipat ang hulma ng *maglinis* sa *kumain*: hindi *magkakain* ang katumbas ng *kakain* sa pangkat na ito.
language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.note: Two verb families receive explicit formation rules and a paired worked application.
